audit.why: Lane difficulty is coherently framed: favoured early/mid for Qiyana (immobile artillery mage vs assassin), harder teamfight angles late due to Hwei zone control. Matches 53.48% WR over 1105 games.
Spikes are right: level 3 full element cycle, level 6 wall-stun, first item lethality, late pick-angle play. spikes[] has all 4 entries.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly names a fabricated Hwei ability 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)'. The real CC palette is Subject: Torment (E, 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s): Grim Visage (fear), Gaze of the Abyss (root), Crushing Maw (pull). Also spikes[3].text cites 'W_EE lantern, disintegrate' — not Hwei ability names. Missing interaction: Subject: Serenity (W, 18s) shields his burst window and was never mentioned.
audit.why: Kit file is authority: Hwei E = Subject: Torment, W = Subject: Serenity (shield flag).
audit.corrected: All references replaced with Subject: Torment and real cooldown numbers; W shield window added to cooldowns; spikes[3] names Gaze of the Abyss / Molten Fissure.

audit.why: Field exists to hold real numbers; E is 12s rank 1, W 18s, Qiyana W 7s.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string pasted verbatim; dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED).
audit.corrected: Both rewritten to match their titles.

edits.before: Drag the shooting range into the hedges and execute the mage who followed. Track Subject: Fear (CC Paints) before every commit and keep the wave where your pattern works.
edits.after: Drag the shooting range into the hedges and execute the mage who followed. Track Subject: Torment (E, 12s at rank 1) before every commit and keep the wave where your pattern works.

edits.before: Hwei wins by landing Subject: Fear (CC Paints), denying your pattern, and renting you the lane at a range markup.
edits.after: Hwei wins by landing Subject: Torment's fear or root, denying your pattern, and renting you the lane at a range markup.

edits.before: - Qiyana vs Hwei - Track: Hwei Subject: Fear (CC Paints). - Element before engagement — the loaded W is the plan. - Engage only on Subject: Fear (CC Paints)’s cooldown. - Spend your ultimate on kill windows only.
edits.after: - Qiyana vs Hwei - Track: Hwei Subject: Torment (E palette). - Element before engagement — the loaded W is the plan. - Engage only on Subject: Torment’s 12s cooldown. - Spend your ultimate on kill windows only.

edits.before: - Hwei Subject: Fear (CC Paints): matchup-defining — All his crowd control lives on the E palette — dodge the fear/root and the burst never chains. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Terrashape (element swap) like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Hwei Subject: Torment (E, 12s rank 1, 10s max): all his crowd control lives on this palette — dodge the fear/root and the burst never chains. - His shield, Subject: Serenity (W), runs an 18s cooldown — it eats your burst, so commit while it is down. - Guard your W Terrashape (7s) like a fifth summoner spell.

edits.before: Grass-Q from stealth, E-ice the answer, auto, walk back into the hedge — terrain trades he experiences as ambush weather.
edits.after: Ice-Q the moment he steps up to cast — the root holds him through your E-auto string and he cannot dash away from any of it.

edits.before: Hwei wastes Subject: Fear (CC Paints) — that is your full-commit window.
edits.after: Hwei wastes Subject: Torment's fear or root — that is your full-commit window.

edits.before: E-ing in with no element loaded and his CC banked — Qiyana without terrain prep is a dagger doing improv.
edits.after: Terrashape is 7 seconds of downtime — swap to the element your next window needs, not the one that just looks fun.

edits.before: Track Hwei’s Subject: Fear (CC Paints): All his crowd control lives on the E palette — dodge the fear/root and the burst never chains. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Track Hwei’s Subject: Torment (E, 12s rank 1): all his crowd control lives on that palette — dodge the fear/root and the burst never chains. It’s down or you don’t go.

edits.before: Commit on Subject: Fear (CC Paints)’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your jungler’s setup. Make him flinch first.
edits.after: Commit on Subject: Torment’s 12s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your jungler’s setup. Make him flinch first.

edits.before: You stay the better skirmisher, but Hwei's zone control (W_EE lantern, disintegrate) can wall you off in teamfights, so pick angles.
edits.after: You stay the better skirmisher, but Hwei's zone control (Gaze of the Abyss, Molten Fissure) can wall you off in teamfights, so pick angles.

edits.before: Land the QW Fleeting Current slow or EQ Grim Visage to peel your dash
edits.after: Land the WQ Fleeting Current slow or EQ Grim Visage to peel your dash
